data.close_reason: The ticket's ACs are provably unachievable as written: AC1 requires capturing a randomisation seed, but pytest-randomly is NOT installed (active plugins: cov, xdist, split, timeout, anyio), so ordering is deterministic collection order and no seed exists. Its stated mechanism (sys.modules leakage across tests) is structurally impossible: the test spawns a fresh interpreter via subprocess, so parent import state cannot cross. Four candidate leak channels (cwd, env, timeout starvation, env-sensitive assertion) were each ruled out with evidence, and nine reproduction runs across four selection strategies were negative. The real defect found during investigation -- a nested-pytest launch that evades the uniqueness guard and destroys other sessions' shared temp roots -- is filed and linked as 16e1-237d-4740-4c79, which is defect-seedable in a way this observation never was.
